sample_unit: clinical vignettes (real-patient cases, each in English and Polish, across six LLMs; 360 unique responses, 720 rater-level evaluations)

links.outcome: LLM diagnostic reasoning score in English versus Polish across six models
links.effect: Qwen2.5, Llama3.3, Meditron3, and OpenBioLLM performed significantly better in English (largest gap for Qwen2.5); GPT-5 and Bielik showed no statistically detectable English-Polish difference in overall score.
links.quote: Qwen2.5, Llama3.3, Meditron3, and OpenBioLLM performed significantly better in English, with the largest gap observed for Qwen2.5.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic reasoning performance and safety-relevant outputs of six LLMs across different input languages (English vs. Polish) using clinical vignettes.
